pairs.label: Condition

pairs.label: Initialize
pairs.detail: Create the starting latent from a recorded seed policy.
pairs.explanation: Create the starting latent from a recorded seed policy. A seed aids investigation but does not guarantee identical pixels across every runtime.

pairs.label: Denoise
pairs.detail: Run sequential model evaluations under the selected scheduler, guidance, precision, and stop rule.
pairs.explanation: Run sequential model evaluations under the selected scheduler, guidance, precision, and stop rule.

pairs.label: Decode
pairs.detail: Transform the latent into an image, then treat the pixels as untrusted output until release checks finish.

pairs.label: Classify the job
pairs.detail: Derive model family, memory class, dimensions, quality tier, deadline, and policy route from the immutable contract.
pairs.explanation: Derive model family, memory class, dimensions, quality tier, deadline, and policy route from the immutable contract.

pairs.label: Choose a compatible queue
pairs.detail: Separate interactive, batch, and review-sensitive work.
pairs.explanation: Separate interactive, batch, and review-sensitive work. Preserve tenant fairness and cap one caller's in-flight GPU seconds.

pairs.label: Lease a warm worker
pairs.detail: Prefer a worker with the required recipe loaded.
pairs.explanation: Prefer a worker with the required recipe loaded. Give the attempt a deadline, heartbeat, cancellation token, and stable job ID.

pairs.label: Reconcile the attempt
pairs.detail: Commit output identity atomically with attempt state.
pairs.explanation: Commit output identity atomically with attempt state. Expired leases may be retried only after checking whether an accepted output already exists.

pairs.label: Worker dies mid-job
pairs.detail: Mark the attempt expired, reconcile any committed output, and retry within a bounded attempt budget on a compatible worker.
pairs.explanation: Mark the attempt expired, reconcile any committed output, and retry within a bounded attempt budget on a compatible worker.

pairs.label: Moderation is unavailable
pairs.detail: Hold or fail closed for policies that require the missing check.
pairs.explanation: Hold or fail closed for policies that require the missing check. Do not silently downgrade a high-risk release path.

pairs.label: Object storage fails
pairs.detail: Keep the job nonterminal until durable storage succeeds.
pairs.explanation: Keep the job nonterminal until durable storage succeeds. Delete orphaned temporary pixels through a reconciler.

pairs.label: Callback delivery fails
pairs.explanation: The completed job remains queryable. Retry signed callbacks independently without rerunning generation.

variants.hint:

Object storage fails: Keep the job nonterminal until durable storage succeeds.

Callback delivery fails: The completed job remains queryable.

variants.prompt: Why should a long generation use an idempotent asynchronous job API?

It lets client retries find the same durable job instead of purchasing duplicate work.
It removes the need for output moderation.
It makes every model fit on one GPU.
